range.description: Save a shared source range, then choose which saved points to add to this recording.

calculation.title: Result for this point
calculation.latestExample: Simulated example: eligible readings 20, 22 and 24 produce latest = 24. Store the most recent eligible value in the recording window; raw recording does not require a measurement definition.
calculation.meanExample: Simulated example: eligible gauge readings 20, 22 and 24 produce arithmetic mean = 22. Observations have equal weight within this point’s window, not across points or weighted by time. Counter and state sources remain latest values in legacy average profiles.
calculation.deltaExample: Counter difference: store the change in a confirmed counter over its own window, for example energy used every minute. It is not the raw cumulative meter reading.
calculation.firstBaseline: The first counter window may establish a baseline only: the result is NULL with a reason, not zero and not the raw reading.
calculation.counterPolicy: A confirmed signed counter can decrease. A rollover is accepted only according to its saved policy; not every decrease is missing data.
calculation.dueUnion: Each point has its own UTC-aligned window. Wide tables leave a point that is not due as NULL / not_due; long tables include only due points. No previous result is copied and no zero is invented.
calculation.requiredPolicy: A due required point that cannot produce its result can skip the row under the saved policy. Optional missing results remain NULL with their reason. A required point that is not due does not skip another point’s row.
calculation.independent: Per-point calculation uses a new independent recording and new counter baseline. Existing recordings, schedules and data are not converted, stopped or copied.
calculation.chooseBeforePoints: Choose this mode before adding points.
calculation.legacyUnchanged: This recording keeps its original group-wide calculation. To choose different results per point, create a separate recording.
calculation.capability: Per-point editing is not supported by this server capability.
calculation.dialect: This destination dialect is not supported for per-point results.
calculation.layout: This saved layout is not supported for per-point results.
calculation.gauge_required: Average needs a confirmed numeric gauge role for this recording or a complete canonical gauge binding. Existing bindings are never removed to make a choice available.
calculation.counter_required: Difference needs a confirmed canonical counter and its policy for this exact source. Confirm it in Basic first.
calculation.unavailable: This calculation is unavailable for the source and saved layout.
calculation.managed_wide_profile_v1: Wide: points share aligned due rows
calculation.savedNotApplied: Saving changes the draft only. Schema, source, ownership and revision checks remain required before explicit activation.

issue.destination-unsaved: Save and confirm the current destination first.
issue.lateness-invalid: Allowed lateness must be a non-negative finite number.
issue.member-cadence-invalid: Each point needs a positive whole-number interval within the server limit.
issue.member-delta-unconfirmed: A difference needs a numeric counter bound to a confirmed measurement.
issue.member-entity-unsupported: This result layout does not support a per-member entity key.
issue.member-exact-source-invalid: Exact counter source evidence is incomplete.
issue.member-mean-inapplicable: An average needs a numeric gauge source.
issue.member-method-unsupported: Choose a supported result for every point.
issue.member-source-duplicate: The same scoped source cannot be added twice.
issue.member-source-required: Every member needs a confirmed device, point and Tag identity.
issue.mixed-dialect-unsupported: This destination dialect does not support per-point results.
issue.mixed-group-interval-forbidden: Per-point recordings cannot also use a group-wide interval.
issue.mixed-layout-unsupported: Choose a supported managed result layout.
issue.mixed-profile-required: This is not a canonical per-point recording draft.
issue.mixed-record-id-invalid: An independent recording identity is required.
issue.mixed-row-policy-invalid: The wide result layout requires its canonical partial-row policy.
issue.mixed-storage-unsupported: Per-point results require supported managed plain storage.
issue.mixed_exact_source_draft_unsupported: Scaled exact counters support difference in a managed long recording only. Create an independent long recording; existing layout and baseline are not converted.
issue.mixed_exact_source_latest_unsupported: This exact scaled source does not support latest-value results.

calculation.mixedExample: Simulated mixed row: readings 20/22/24 average to 22; 10/12/14 average to 12; a confirmed counter from 100 to 108 gives 8. Each result uses its own aligned window. These examples are not acquired values or SQL receipts.
calculation.confirmGauge: Confirm gauge meaning for this recording
calculation.gaugeConfirmationMeaning: Confirm this is a gauge (such as temperature or pressure), not a cumulative value or state code. This choice affects only this recording; it does not change the source or create a measurement definition.
calculation.gaugeConfirmed: Gauge meaning explicitly confirmed for this recording.

result.title: Applied per-point result windows

result.health: Result evidence is not a source connection or health test.
result.firstBaseline: First reading establishes a baseline; the difference is NULL.

navigation.title: Leave this recording?
navigation.description: Unsaved fields exist only on this page. Keep editing, or explicitly discard them before leaving. Reload restores only confirmed saved data.
navigation.savedSources: Devices, read ranges, point formats and counter definitions already saved remain saved. Discarding this recording does not undo them.
navigation.pending: Submitted changes are not cancelled by leaving. Their outcome may still be pending or unknown; inspect the saved state before submitting again.
navigation.unknownSave: A previous save result is unconfirmed. Review the saved records before submitting again; leaving does not cancel the submitted change. A new blank form does not restore or resend it.
navigation.refreshFailed: The latest workspace read failed. Your unsaved fields remain on this page; the displayed saved data may be stale. Refresh before saving or starting.

destinations.title: Choose a configured table

preparation.testWritePending: An existing destination test still needs recovery. Use its original operation status below; no new test is required.

stage.saved: Configuration saved. Check its current schema impact next.
stage.review: Preview only — review every table change before confirming.
stage.lookup: A submitted operation is unresolved. Check that same operation.
stage.ready: Saved configuration is ready according to the current checks. Starting remains a separate action.
stage.schemaConfirmed: The schema operation completed. Recheck the current saved configuration.
stage.offline: Offline — keep editing, then reconnect to check or submit.
stage.blocked: Resolve the current restriction before checking or submitting.
stage.sourceReview: First review the changed source settings

blocker.missing_scope: Save the recording and its destination first.
blocker.scope_mismatch: This observation belongs to another scope. Reload the intended recording.
blocker.unreadable: The current operation could not be verified. Retry its check before a new command.
blocker.readonly: This recording is currently read-only or another change is pending.
blocker.destination: Save and review the current destination first.
blocker.operation_unresolved: Check the submitted operation instead of replacing it.

impact.previewOnly: Preview describes proposed schema changes, not applied schema or recorded data.

start.title: Start this recording
start.scopeNote: Only this saved recording and its listed source devices will start. Other recordings are not selected or stopped.
start.noSql: Starting the sources does not prove that a row has reached the database.
start.changed: The reviewed configuration or source state changed, or fresh readiness is unavailable. Close this review, refresh the saved state, then review again.
start.waiting: Sources started — waiting for the first matching SQL write.
start.unknown: The original start is unresolved. Leaving does not cancel it; check its original status instead of starting again.
start.incomplete: The original start has not completed. Review its status and required next action.
start.confirm: Start this recording and these sources
start.lookupFailed: The original operation could not be read. Its outcome remains unconfirmed; no replacement request was sent.
start.committed: A matching SQL write is confirmed.
start.notReadback: This is a committed-write receipt, not a readback or cleanup claim.
start.deliveryUnavailable: Delivery evidence is unavailable. Waiting does not mean the start failed.
start.previousTerminal: The previous start completed for an older saved configuration. This review requires a new explicit start for the settings shown above.
start.recoveryUnavailable: The original operation cannot be inspected or safely retained. No new start was sent. Preserve the unresolved operation and review its status; do not clear its recovery data.
start.reviewSavedNote: Review the selected recordings and sources, then explicitly confirm to start.
